title: Plant Manager/ CDL Mixer Operator - Ready Mix Concrete
text:
About the Opportunity:

We are seeking a hands-on Plant Manager / CDL Mixer Operator to oversee the daily operations of our ready mix concrete plant while also operating a concrete mixer truck as business demands require. This is a working management position ideal for someone who enjoys leading a team, maintaining efficient plant operations, and providing excellent customer service in the field.

The successful candidate will ensure safe, efficient production and delivery of quality concrete while maintaining high standards for customer service, equipment maintenance, and regulatory compliance.

Your Mission & Key Responsibilities:

* ### **Plant Operations**

 + Oversee daily batching and production of ready mix concrete.
 + Schedule production and deliveries to meet customer needs.
 + Supervise plant employees and coordinate daily work assignments.
 + Monitor inventory of cement, aggregates, admixtures, and other materials.
 + Ensure quality control standards are maintained.
 + Coordinate equipment maintenance and repairs to minimize downtime.
 + Maintain a clean, organized, and safe plant environment.
 + Ensure compliance with OSHA, DOT, environmental, and company safety policies.
 + Complete production reports and maintain accurate operational records.

 ### **CDL Mixer Operations**

 + Operate a ready mix concrete mixer truck (Class A or Class B CDL) when needed.
 + Safely transport and deliver concrete to commercial and residential job sites.
 + Perform pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections.
 + Maintain delivery documentation and DOT compliance.
 + Communicate effectively with dispatch, customers, and job site personnel.
 + Assist with plant and yard duties during downtime.

What Sets You Apart:

* Valid Class A or Class B CDL with current DOT Medical Card required.
* Previous ready mix concrete plant management or supervisory experience preferred.
* Experience operating a concrete mixer truck.
* Knowledge of batching systems and concrete production.
* Strong leadership and organizational skills.
* Excellent customer service and communication abilities.
* Commitment to safety and regulatory compliance.
* Mechanical aptitude with the ability to identify and troubleshoot equipment issues.
* Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Ability to climb ladders, lift up to 100 pounds, and perform physical job duties as needed.

About SRM:

SRM Concrete (Smyrna Ready Mix) is a family-owned, values-driven leader in the ready mix concrete industry. Founded in 1999 with a single plant in Smyrna, Tennessee, we’ve grown to over 600 locations nationwide by focusing on quality, integrity, and service. Our mission is to serve our customers, our communities, and our team members with excellence—every load, every day.Why Join SRM Concrete?

**Why Join SRM Concrete?**

* **Growth & Advancement:** Be part of a rapidly expanding company with real opportunities to grow your career.
* **Impact:** Lead a team that plays a pivotal role in building America’s future.
* **Competitive Pay & Exceptional Benefits:** Low-cost medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance; paid holidays; PTO/vacation; 401k with $100 weekly match; family days; and more!
* **Team Culture:** We value hard work, respect, and teamwork. We support each other, recognize a job well done, and believe in doing what’s right—on the job and in the community. You’ll find a straightforward, dependable environment where every team member matters.

At SRM Concrete, you’re more than a manager—you’re a valued team member helping to build America’s future. If you’re ready to say “YES” to new opportunities and deliver service that sets the standard in our industry, apply today and join the SRM family!
